properties.notes: reconciled: the photo-traced roof p004 and FP167 (candidate c00679, a dashed 4.5 m hut on 2-SE-9B, Jan 1981) are one building: on the Dec 1982 photo a light roof about 6 x 7 m covers the hut's north half and runs about 5 m further north, while the hut's south half is open ground. Both readers of p004 saw a real roof and called it the same building as FP167; the first-round reader of FP167 saw the same. The building keeps the id FP167; its Dec 1982 outline is the roof, its 1981 outline is kept as sheet_outline_1981 | light-grey roof north of and overlapping the sheet hut FP167 | Uniform light-grey roof with straight edges, rotated about 4 deg clockwise; a bright strip about 0.7 m wide along its south edge (eave or gutter, included); dark shadow and tree along the north side. It overlaps the north half of FP167 (the sheet TS square, Jan 1981): the roof south edge is at N 840629.0-840629.4 and the FP167 north edge at about N 840632, so about 2.5-3 m of overlap. The roof has the same E-W width and position as FP167 but lies 1.5-3 m further north even after allowing for the 0.85 m sheet offset, so it is either FP167 rebuilt or extended northward after the survey, or a separate roof built over its north part. A reviewer should decide whether this replaces FP167 or is added beside it; it is not part of FP167 as drawn. Sheet (2-SE-9B): nothing drawn north of FP167. | reader: Bright uniform roof with straight edges and a shadow N; the outline follows it within ~0.5 m.
